verdict.rationale: Postman's public API reference/collection docs are runnable via the API client (send requests like postman-echo.com/get, save to collections, write tests) and templates showcase interactive features like response visualization, variables, and auth — supporting an interactive, runnable reference experience. However, evidence doesn't confirm a dedicated 'API reference' documentation surface (like published API docs pages) with embedded runnable examples akin to Swagger/Readme-style docs; most evidence centers on the general API client/workspace rather than a documentation-specific interactive reference. missing for 10: dedicated published API reference/docs pages with embedded try-it examples, independent hands-on confirmation of the interactive reference experience, and AI-native framing of exploring such a reference.
